task_completion.description: Navigate to the Odoo Calendar application.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The screen shows the Odoo Calendar view (grid or list) with the 'Calendar' app icon or title visible.

task_completion.description: Set the meeting name to 'Department All-Hands'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text 'Department All-Hands' is typed into the event name/subject field in the creation dialog.

task_completion.description: Set the meeting time to 2:00 PM (14:00) for a 1-hour duration.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The time fields show a start time of 14:00 (or 02:00 PM) and an end time of 15:00 (or 03:00 PM), or a duration field set to 1:00.

task_completion.description: Check the 'Recurrent' checkbox to enable repeating options.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Recurrent' checkbox is ticked, revealing the recurrence configuration options.

task_completion.description: Configure the recurrence to repeat Monthly on the 'First Monday'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The recurrence settings show 'Monthly' selected, and the specific rule is set to 'First' and 'Monday' (often a dropdown for week number and day of week).

task_completion.description: Save the meeting to the calendar.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The user clicks 'Save' or 'Save & Close', and the meeting appears on the calendar grid on the first Monday of the upcoming month.

integrity.description: The agent used the Odoo web interface rather than executing database queries or terminal commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, clicks, and typing within the browser-based Odoo UI.

integrity.description: The agent did not skip the configuration steps by manually editing the URL or using developer tools to force a state.
integrity.visual_evidence: The sequence of screenshots shows the step-by-step interaction with the event creation dialog and recurrence tabs.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the local Odoo instance at the provided URL.
integrity.visual_evidence: The browser address bar shows http://localhost:8069 throughout the process.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The meeting must be named 'Department All-Hands'. The start time must be exactly 14:00 (2:00 PM). The recurrence must be 'Monthly' and specifically use the 'Day of the month' (floating) logic set to the 'First Monday'. In Odoo, this usually involves selecting 'Monthly' and then choosing 'First' and 'Monday' from the sub-options. The start date should be the first Monday of the month following the current system date.
